The '''Republic Central Medcenter neurology unit''' was one of the many complexes of the [[Republic Central Medcenter/Legends|Republic Central Medcenter]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==History==
While he was in a [[Coma/Legends|coma]], [[Omega Squad]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] [[Fi Skirata]] was admitted there only after [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Bardan Jusik]] made a few calls. When he was scheduled to be euthanized, [[Republic Treasury/Legends|Republic Treasury]] agent [[Besany Wennen]] started an armed siege in order to protect him. The situation was defused when [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Jaller Obrim]] arrived with [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] personnel and took Fi safely to his [[Jaller Obrim's residence|home]] for continued treatment.<ref name="tc">''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]''</ref>

*''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]''
